S2 E4 — Go Get Mommy's BraAfter Charlie reluctantly lends Evelyn his new car, he later discovers her bra in the back seat. Meanwhile, Alan is forced to compensate after Jake gets attached to Judith's rich and talented boyfriend.

Find out what's going on in the world with a news bulletin designed for children, featuring stories that are relevant and easy to understand.
After Dr Sturgis experiences a nervous breakdown, Mary worries Sheldon is headed down a similar path.
This week at the Columbus Zoo: daredevil flying goats, adorable cheetah cubs, a cranky female tiger, a lethal king cobra and a rhino that paints!
Four young know-it-alls try to get their hands on Tom Gleeson's Big Brass Mug, but which eclectic topic will win the day: The Listies, Homer's The Odyssey, My Chemical Romance, or orangutans?
Merlin sees a shocking new side to Morgana when Mordred returns to Camelot asking for her help.
Jessica and Honey's friendship hits a rough patch after an argument about the investment property, Louis' old friend Barry overstays his welcome, and Eddie starts a part-time job working for DMX.

At an amusement arcade, Teddy accidentally gets put in a claw machine as a prize!
Mr Bean builds an alarm clock to wake him up in time for a comet fly-by
A power failure at the Pokemon Centre leads Ash and his new friend May to an astonishing discovery!

p.t: Thomas And Friends: Big World! Big Adventures!
p.d: Sonny is trying to prove himself to be a useful engine so that he can stay working on Sodor, but nobody seems to trust him. nobody apart from Diesel, that is! But can Diesel be trusted?
It's time for bed. Peppa and George have a bath and brush their teeth so Daddy Pig can read them a story. Soon they are fast asleep. Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig finally sit down but they are sleepy too.
It is Sports Day with lots of events, including running, jumping and 'tug of war'. Dad tells Peppa that it's not the winning that matters but taking part, but she would really like to win a prize.
Small needs a new broom, and while she's out Pants gets surprise visitors.
When Ginger and the Baby Pea-Rexes' yummy drops get snatched by a group of Beetrootsaurus, so begins a game of Pea-in-the-Middle to get them back.
Mr Elf is overworked so King Thistle sentences him to a holiday. He isn't too pleased. Mrs Elf and Ben however are overjoyed at the news. Meanwhile Nanny takes over the food deliveries.
Popcorn breaks the x-ray machine and does everything he can to fix it before Vida finds out.
Becca helps the Heroes take a unique approach when they battle a giant monster made of trash.
Santi and crew get magically transported to the past, where they team up with young Abuelo to get back to the present!

A beautiful pig is about to become pork chops if she keeps digging up the family property with her broken nose ring. Her owner begs Chris to find a way to stop the execution.

Honey the spoodle leapt from a car doing 40 km/h to chase a cat. She survived, but how bad are her injuries? Owner Ilana's riddled with guilt for not strapping her in—and wait till you see Honey's reaction when she hears cats out the back.
Chris finally has a weekend off vet duties and is heading to Newcastle to catch up with his parents. But a call from his dad about a bizarre snake emergency sends him on a fascinating detour.

A game of chasey at home turns ugly for Hooligan when he runs into his owner, Sarah. Hooligan's horribly fractured leg needs major surgery at Sash, but the tiny terrier has never spent a night away from his family and is not coping.
Chris is confronted with the smallest patient he has ever handled. A young girl's much-loved pet mouse, Pinot has developed a massive tumour. But surgery on such a small patient is a challenge.

Homer the turtle is going on holidays while his owner is overseas. What can go wrong? Well try finding the little fellow in the fangs of the resident pooch. Babysitter Jody is guilt ridden and the traumatised Homer is the victim of a big bacteria bite. Can Chris save the day for everyone?

Chris heads to the Victorian high country to help out a mate and to realise a boyhood dream of becoming a vet in the bush. It’s a challenging week as he treats everything from horses to wombats and monkeys and helps save a mother in trouble. Monkeys carry some nasty diseases and watch for Chris’ concerns about what he might leave Mansfield with. Talk about a dangerous job.

Observe as Chris treats Pearl, a poodle that began bleeding internally at the groomer, while surgeons try to save Zoe, a cat that dove off a second-floor balcony. Meanwhile, the clinic gets a special gift from a grateful patient.

Join the team’s 24-hour vigil for Lucu, a pup that’s been bitten by a tick. Then check out Jonti, a cat with a gaping hole in his neck that’s scarily close to his jugular vein—all while Chris tangles with an evasive lame emu.
A bizarre looking baby cockatoo has fallen twenty metres out of her nest and wants to alert the whole world to her plight. Can Chris help the little screamer? And will she ever be able to fly?

Chris fights to save one of the clinic’s favorite patients. Beautiful Bluebell was dumped on the doorstep of the clinic as a kitten and adopted out to a loving family. Now he is the victim of a hit run accident.

The Australian Reptile Park operations manager, Tim Faulkner ropes Chris into a frightening mission in far north Queensland. A monster seven metre python called Big Mamma is living in the roof of a local boating club and the female paddlers are terrified. It's all up to the intrepid duo as they head to Cairns to try to capture the scary reptile.

A quick thinking police officer in Sydney’s infamous King Cross has rescued a twelve-week old puppy and rushed her into the Bondi clinic. The puppy was found sweltering in forty degree heat in a plastic handbag and the culprit has been arrested. Little Tilly soon finds a place in Chris’ heart and home where she has a confrontation with the resident cat, George. Without a microchip, the search is on for her owner.

A morning walk has gone tragically wrong for Tigger and his distressed owner Bernadette. A street cleaner spooked it and sent him charging into a car. Chris is trying to calm them both down to find out the extent of his injuries.

Ziggy is a dog with an embarrassing problem. A huge mass is hanging off his back leg. Bemused vet nurse Neil tells us it's like a third testicle swinging in the wind. But when it comes to surgery it's no laughing matter for Chris.

22 July 1946. The headquarters of the British Army in Palestine is located in the luxurious King David Hotel. Members of the Irgun, the Jewish resistance movement, smuggle milk churns packed with explosives into the hotel and hide them in the basement.

30 September 1956. For over a century Algeria has been a colony of France and the Algerians are fed up with it. A young Algerian woman visits a bar in the European quarter of Algiers. She orders ice cream, plants a bomb underneath her chair, and leaves the establishment.

5 September 1972. For the first time ever, the Olympic Games are broadcast live on television. Early in the morning of September 5, eight Palestinians, members of the Black September movement, attack the apartments of the Israeli delegation and kill two athletes.

2 August 1980. A suitcase is left in the lobby of Bologna Central Station and explodes not long after. The gigantic explosion rips the station building apart and a train waiting to leave for Chiasso is torn to shreds. 85 people are killed and 200 are injured.

12 October 2000. The American naval vessel USS Cole docks in Aden, Yemen to refuel. Two men approach in a small boat. They wave to the crew before ramming the ship at full speed. The resulting explosion kills seventeen sailors.

22 July 2011. Anders Breivik detonates a bomb in Oslo's government quarter. In the midst of the ensuing chaos, he drives to the island of Utøya, where youth members of the Labour party have just started their annual summer camp. When he arrives, he opens fire on the young adults.

Ice is the deadliest enemy. Former soldier and archaeologist Ben Timberlake is on a mission to reveal the ice's role in wars past, present, and future. From hunting lost WW1 bunkers in Italy, to secret Cold War nuclear bases in Greenland's ice, to modern-day Arctic espionage on Russia's border.

Nearly six years of our lives are spent dreaming. Yet there is so much untapped creative potential in our dreams. What if we could take the brilliant ideas from our dreams and turn them into reality? How can we make our dreams more meaningful?

No one lives forever, but scientists will never stop trying to combat aging. Now, laboratories around the world have been successful with rejuvenation in animals such as mice and fruit flies. If animals are living longer and healthier lives, can this research benefit humans?

Air travel is a climate killer. But if we stop flying we'll have a global logistics problem, with numerous supply chains interrupted. If we want to keep flying, it's time for a revolutionary energy transformation. Luckily, the necessary technologies already exist.

Thanks to Artificial Intelligence, robots can recognize us, drive cars, perform surgeries with precision, create art and play a perfect game of chess. But can robots also have feelings? Will we ever consider robots our friends, or love them like real humans? And above all, can they love us back?

Spencer returns to the fantastical world of Jumanji. His friends Martha, Fridge, and Bethany follow his footsteps in an effort to try and bring him home.

S11 E1 — Episode 1With millions of CCTV cameras lining our streets and roads they've become an invaluable tool for the Police to track down criminals.

S3 E6 — Episode 6The show that delivers the spills & thrills of the road directly to your living room. From parking fails to holiday disasters, even a dog riding a horse – we've guaranteed every form of entertainment!
S5 E8 — Episode 8The team land at a motocross crash where Dr Andy must act fast to save a rider. Pilot Andy avoids a mid-air collision before heading to a quarry fight.
S15 E6 — Episode 6A husband and wife get washed off rocks by a massive wave; the lifeguards search for the couple and hope it does not become a body retrieval.

S18 E104 — Episode 104Pet owners claim their dog groomer caused their Chow to have a heat stroke while he was in her care.

S2 E22 — Episode 22A sniffer dog raids a car suspected of carrying drugs. A British citizen claims to be returning to Canada in the hope of reconciling with his partner, but his story doesn't convince officers.
S15 E18 — Episode 18An Martial Arts fighter claims he bought a bottle of cologne at a market in Thailand but Border Force know there's more to his story. Testing reveals the truth.

S13 E17 — Episode 17In New Zealand, the term 'Police Ten 7' means 'Police have arrived on the scene'. This unique fly-on-the-wall reality series brims with action as it follows urban cops on the beat.

S2 E10 — Speed Drink SuspendOfficers Henry and Emmanouel are called to a fatal accident at railway crossing. And a driver, who has hit a few cars on his way back from McDonalds, seems too drunk to answer some easy questions.
S3 E3 — Episode 3With three million dashcams now in vehicles, a look at some of Britain's worst driving offenders.
S12 E1 — Episode 1Tom chases a fleeing petrol thief, Mike corners a criminal in a text-book manoeuvre, and Jim deals with a suspect who can't control his tongue or bladder.

S30 E8 — Jumping The GunSurrounded by officers, a passenger makes a bold move. Tempers flare between roommates after a woman feeds eggs to her dog. A deputy acts swiftly when he spots a dangerous object in the car's back seat.

p.t: Bridget Jones: Mad About the Boy
p.d: After jumping back into the dating pool, single mother Bridget Jones finds herself caught between a younger man and her son's science teacher.
As college tests their relationship, a freshman quarterback and a promising dancer navigate love and distance while searching for who they're meant to be.

A shark-obsessed serial killer holds Zephyr, a rebellious surfer, captive on his boat. Racing against time, she must figure out a way to escape before he carries out a ritualistic feeding to the sharks below.
In a barrage of fists, gunfire and squealing tires, an enraged man must save his wife and son from a dangerous adversary, and ensure that no one will underestimate him again.

Workaholic assassin Hutch Mansell takes his family on a much-needed holiday to the small tourist town of Plummerville. However, he soon finds himself in the crosshairs of a corrupt theme-park operator, a shady sheriff, and a bloodthirsty crime boss.
When his beloved wife, Kathryn, is suspected of betraying the nation, intelligence agent George Woodhouse faces the ultimate test -- loyalty to his marriage or his country.
Old tensions resurface when former bandmates who were former lovers reunite for a private show at the island home of an eccentric millionaire.
Two young men during World War I set out to record the lives, voices and music of their American countrymen.
A retail employee infiltrates the inner circle of an artist on the verge of stardom. As he gets closer to the budding music star, access and proximity become a matter of life and death.
Explores Nick Cave's creative process and influence through reflections from collaborators and artists, delving into the shadowy, mythic stories and inspirations that define his music.

A standoff between a small-town sheriff and mayor sparks a powder keg as neighbour is pitted against neighbour in May 2020 in Eddington, N.M.
America's commander-in-chief places his political future at risk when he starts dating a dynamic lobbyist.
After a one-night stand, a couple decide to get married. However, it turns out to be a rocky road when both parties have to compromise their own cultural traditions.

p.t: How to Lose a Guy in 10 Days
p.d: An advice columnist attempts to make a man dump her in 10 days, but he makes a bet with his boss that he will make her fall in love with him.

A man is killed by a mugger and returns as his young girlfriend's ghostly guardian. Realising, in his spirit state, that his murder was premeditated and that her life is in great danger, he tries to make contact through a fake spiritualist.
After a freak bus accident, struggling musician Jack Malik wakes up to discover that no one has ever heard of the Beatles. When he plays the band's songs, he becomes an overnight sensation.

Young Remi has her future figured out, until she meets Barnes, who lives for the moment and makes her question everything. As their love story unfolds, she faces a choice -- stick to her plan or risk it all for a life she never saw coming.
When three best friends vow to get married within a year, each woman experiences her own difficulties getting to the altar.

Ethan Hunt must bring down a ruthless villain and rescue his fiancee.
Four high-school kids discover an old video game console and are immediately drawn into the game's jungle setting, learning you don't just play Jumanji, you must survive it.
As they return to Jumanji to rescue one of their own, nothing is as they expect. They will have to brave parts unknown and unexplored to escape the world's most dangerous game.

Brad Pitt stars as a hitman whose latest mission puts him on a bullet train travelling from Tokyo to Morioka, alongside deadly adversaries from around the world. The question is: who will make it off the train alive at the final station?
A struggling musician realises he's the only person on Earth who can remember The Beatles after waking up in an alternate reality where they never existed.

Oakland As general manager Billy Beane attempts to build a competitive baseball team on a tight budget, using computer-driven analysis to recruit undervalued players and challenge the traditional way the game is run.
When Cecilia's abusive ex takes his own life and leaves her his fortune, she suspects his death was a hoax. As a series of coincidences turn lethal, Cecilia works to prove that she is being hunted.
When a mysterious prisoner lands in his jail, a border town sheriff faces the wrath of a brutal cartel.
Five high school students meet in Saturday detention and discover how they have a great deal more in common than they thought.
When an island populated by happy, flightless birds is visited by mysterious green piggies, it's up to three unlikely outcasts - Red, Chuck and Bomb - to figure out what the pigs are up to.
A ghost teams up with a psychic to uncover the truth behind his murder - and to rescue his sweetheart from a similar fate.
In 19th-century France, Jean Valjean, who for decades has been hunted by the ruthless policeman Javert after breaking parole, agrees to care for a factory worker's daughter.

Olympic bronze medalist and ten-time X Games medalist Mark McMorris wants the world to know there's more to snowboarding than tricks and trophies. Traveling the world and riding with the sport's best, he explores snowboard culture.

Skimboard odysseys include South Africa, Hawaii, Brazil, Mexico, Laguna Beach, Newport Beach, and LA County. If you haven't seen this video, then you haven't seen the longest, most epic waves ever skimmed. Directed by Bill and George Bryan. Starring Bill Bryan, George Bryan, Morgan Just, Erick Rosenberry, Jackson Tenney, Chris da Canha.

Jack Coleman's Nameless Direction Underground premieres his fourth fully independent feature length surf film. Groove Move celebrates the pure heart and soul of surfing, with the world's top experimental board riders. Directed by Jack Coleman. Derek Hynd, Dave Rastovich, Alex Knost, Joel Tudor, Ozzie Wright, Rob Machado, Ford Archbold and more.

p.t: Just Getting Started - Bringing it Home
p.d: S1 E7Episode 7 of Just Getting Started covers the thrilling UCI race at Mont Sainte-Anne. The Norco Race Division team celebrated an amazing finish, with Gracey's top performance, Greg's strong UCI career finale, and Kirk's impressive 16th place. A weekend of passion, home support, and racing history!

Field Productions is proud to present their eighth ski movie installment. With some of the best skiers in modern freeskiing, and a passionate film crew equipped with the best of HD cameras, this movie will both thrill and amaze you.

p.t: Drive Thru - Europe - Halloween in France
p.d: S2 E13With the last day of the trip just around the corner, the swell couldn't have come at a better time. The crew wakes up to near flawless conditions just in front of the house. The locals are out in force as are the typical crowds of spectators on the beach. Great waves are had by all. The crew spends Halloween in France and reflects back on the great times and get ready to return home.

p.t: Drive Thru - South Africa - The Beginning
p.d: S3 E1The Crew Arrive in Capetown, SA and begin their 2 week adventure up and down the wild coast of South Africa. Upon their arrival they meet up with locals Ant and Adam who will help guide them on there journey. After the long plane ride the crew are ready to surf and stumble upon one of Capetown's favorite waves.  Along the way they drive thru incredible scenery and some treacherous roads.

Before fatherhood, Australian surfer/filmmaker/musician Nick Colbey takes one last must-do trip. The Buckety is self-shot, self-narrated and self-scored as he chases dream waves from Hawaii to South Africa, then the UK and Ireland-through missed flights, wipeouts and kind strangers. Less performance, more presence.

S1 E6Hawaiian photographer, Clark Little, chooses cameras to suit the occasion and captures the drama of the winter's first swells. The bigger, darker, more turbulent waves of the new season are here, and Clark is ready to capture them.

The T.A.P.S. crew investigate the Race Rock Lighthouse located in the Long Island Sound, off the coast of New London, Connecticut. The investigation proves unusually difficult not only because of a lack of electricity in the facility, but also the harsh conditions and strong undertow which surround the lighthouse.

T.A.P.S. investigates the Eastern State Penitentiary in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania which opened in 1829 and officially closed in 1970. During the investigation, the crew uncovers a piece of video footage so baffling, they are inspired to return again (in the same episode) for a two-night stay in order to gather more evidence.
This investigation focuses on some friends of Brian's whose home is a deconsecrated 19th century church.
TAPS investigates an armory in New Bedford, Mass. A camera detects a warm mist passing in front of the lens.

Reports of disturbances in a college student group house are easily explained as acoustics and encounters with neighbors who were drunk at the time.At the Topton House Pub, witnesses have reported that the ghost of a little girl sometimes trips people on the steps and has moved glasses of soda on one table. The daughter of the owner has also smelled roses while in the cellar and heard murmurring voices.The smells and voices are explained, and no evidence is found of any other paranormal activity.Jason shows Frank DeAngelis the footage from the Armory.
Mike Sinclair, the founder of O.R.I.O.N. Paranormal, has called in TAPS to co-investigate the New Boston Inn.
TAPS goes to Albany, NY to the home of Linda Johnson. Plus, they meet a man experiencing strange events.
TAPS goes to New Orleans to investigate one of the “most haunted” places in the U.S.
TAPS helps a family whose young children claim to be tormented by ghosts.
TAPS is called back to New Orleans for a case with a female spirit who won’t leave the male homeowner alone.

When Grant and Wilson decide to take the new trainees to the birthplace of President Andrew Johnson in order to further their ghost hunter training with hands-on experience, an unexpected sickness forces them to reconsider the investigation.
TAPS visits a playhouse with a long history of hauntings but their investigation doesn’t yield any evidence.

The team attempts to assess the likelihood of paranormal activity at a lighthouse after seeing the fearful reaction of a Japanese team of supernatural investigators, and they learn of a former keeper who committed suicide after his wife left him.
A boy claims he is being attacked by an entity while his mother suffers dizzy spells in the basement.
TAPS searches for paranormal evidence at a lavish historical estate in Rhode Island.

When Mr Deen discovers one of his students has been living out of his car and thrown into jail, he decides to bail him out. Determined to curb Nate’s self-destructive behaviour, Deen quickly discovers a host of dark secrets slowly tearing Nate apart. What began as a good deed becomes a desperate fight to save Nate from his own demons. As Nate spirals deeper into despair, Deen must decide how far he’s willing to go to save a kid on the brink of losing everything—even himself.

Comedy All-Stars brings together a lineup of hilarious, family-friendly comedians for a night of clean, feel-good laughter. Featuring top talent who prove you don’t need crude jokes to be funny, this series delivers quick wit, clever humour, and plenty of joy. From laugh-out-loud stand-up to relatable storytelling, Comedy All-Stars is the perfect reminder that a good laugh really is the best medicine - and it’s even better when you can share it with the whole family.

Whirl is a Bible-based cartoon series about the loveable, sometimes overly-enthusiastic kids of First Second Church. In each episode, the kids tackle a different theme that is central to Christian values. Everything from generosity and forgiveness to doubt and the trinity are explored over the course of the series. And while the issues dealt with in each episode are relatable, the solutions this kooky cast often find are a bit… unconventional. Whether the kids of First Second Church are searching for a hidden sanctum of the church's altar guild, or trying to outsmart robots bent on world domination, these characters will keep the whole family laughing and learning.

An action-packed, award-winning animated series featuring real-life heroes of the faith. Aimed at children from ages 8 to 12, the series highlights the honour, integrity and life-changing experiences of those well-known and little-known Christian men, women and children who, in response to God's call, dedicated themselves to a life of whole-hearted commitment and passionate service to Jesus. Heroes, or 'Torchlighters' featured include William Tyndale, Perpetua, Jim Elliot, Amy Carmichael, Gladys Aylward, John Bunyan, Richard Wurmbrand, Eric Liddell and more.

Discover how similar we are to our faith ancestors from the Old Testament. These hilarious animations reveal more about Bible heroes, villains, and everyday folks that God selected to do extraordinary things.

Bruce Downes is The Catholic Guy. Bruce and his team will move, inspire and challenge you to live your life to the absolute fullest. No matter your age, situation or background, be prepared to laugh, learn and listen to what God is trying to say to you. Bruce travels Australia speaking regularly about his experiences in life and in the Church in a way that is both relatable and easy to understand. Bruce's message of power, impact, freedom and purpose is for anyone and everyone - for no matter where you are around the world today, God is never far from you.

Gary Kent is the speaker for The Incredible Journey. He is an archaeologist who has excavated numerous sites throughout Israel and Jordan. He holds a BA in Theology, MA in Ancient History And Archaeology, and M in Divinity. As an internationally-acclaimed speaker and TV presenter, he has spoken and produced numerous documentaries on subjects including the Bible, Bible prophecy, world events, historical places and natural health. His passion is to share the good news of Jesus’ soon return.

The Century Series defined the Cold War era of aviation, charting a shift from one time period to another in the U.S. arms race with the Soviet Union.
The Learjet defined the business jet class of luxury airplanes. Now, the last Learjet is being assembled at its Wichita-based production facility.
This is the remarkable story of the definitive German fighter plane and its greatest exponent, Adolf Galland. He was a deadly ace who was respected on both sides of the Channel.
Crude yet pretty, and devastatingly deadly, the Yak 3 and its siblings were Soviet Russia's best fighter planes of WWII. They were taken into combat by the world's first female front line pilots.

Early outer space exploration was defined by a Space Race between the United States and the Soviet Union, in a quest for national bragging rights.
The cosmos has forever fascinated humans. Now, space exploration and satellites provide discoveries about climate change, natural disasters, and more.
Advances in tech and private investments enable a new era in space exploration. Billionaires are leading the charge, and the impacts are profound.
Space exploration continues. There are still problems to solve before humans are ready to make a trip to Mars, but doing it could change everything.

There is no equal on the battlefield to the indomitable presence of the tank. For the last century, the tank has laid siege to front lines, provided protection to infantry, and struck fear into the hearts of its enemies. This special episode of Battlefields chronicles the development and evolution of this metal beast, from its birth in WWI to its deployment in modern urban warfare.

It's a family affair as Mike Holmes hands over the reins to his son, Mike Jr., who is overwhelmed by the pressures of running such a huge project for such a tough client.

A couple hired a contractor to build a wheelchair-accessible ramp in front of their house, but the ramp is not up to code and is a safety hazard, so renovation expert and host Mike Holmes comes to the rescue to rebuild the ramp.

Dig deep with homeowners Michelle and Jason, who have asked Mike for a bailout on their leaky basement. Check out the numerous patches that failed to fix the issue, then see the crew take it outside, where an excavation reveals the real problem.

A woman hired a contractor to remodel her garage, but all he did was take $20,000 and leave her with an ugly and flimsy space, so Mike Holmes arrives to transform the garage into a comfy studio where she can paint and relax.

Take a look at Julia’s basement redo, which went awry because the contractors didn’t do their due diligence with her new laminate floor. See Mike assess the encroaching mold, then get a lesson in under-floor heating and smart subflooring.

A couple has a troubling problem with their roof that is leaking and Mike is forced to demolish the existing roof in order to install a water-tight membrane to prevent any new leaks and then re-roof the entirety of the new house over the membrane.

Consider the options for Kerry, who hired a contractor to lay a concrete floor in her entryway but ended up with an ugly, uneven mess. Join Mike as he proves that this bad reno isn’t written in stone and gives the homeowner a dreamy granite floor.

After MJ and Lisa's wedding, Mike and MJ return to the river house and install deck posts and windows as they rush to get the house closed in before the winter weather arrives; the team takes on a new project with a new property.

Mike hits a structural snag while constructing his vision for open concept at the suburban house, and MJ is forced to rein him in to save the budget; the guys receive a fun surprise at the river house, but Mike soon throws a curveball at MJ.

Every year, the biggest elephant congregation in Asia occurs in Minneriya National Park. Here in this sacred place, baby Loka is born. Watch as he learns to suckle, swim and handle his trunk among the mêlée of giants that make up his family.

Head out into the Pantanal with Lizzie and the Onçafari team on the hunt for a missing dominant male jaguar. Monitor the battle between young hopefuls, like outsider Badalo, who want to usurp his power and win over Fera and the other local females.

The Lilayi Elephant Nursery near Lusaka in Zambia is home to four orphan elephants. The two oldest, four-year- olds Musolole and Zambezi, have been here since they were just a few months old. These boisterous babies are out-growing the nursery and it's time to move to big school. Two hundred miles away, in the heart of Kafue National Park, lies elephant heaven - Camp Phoenix, the project's release facility, where older orphans are already adapting to life in the wild.

Kasanka National Park in Zambia is home to an unusual species of baboon. Kinda baboons have turned their backs on the aggressive displays of dominance usually associated with these large monkeys and lead altogether more peaceful lives. Living alongside one troop is a dedicated team of researchers whose mission it is to uncover these baboons' secrets and understand what makes them who they are.

Africa is a continent filled with unique and extraordinary creatures whose lives are shaped by millions of years of evolution. Africa is also the birthplace of humankind. We traveled alongside the continent's animals on our own journey of evolution, yet intelligence took us on a very different path. Our curiosity led to questions about the world around us which were answered through stories, myths and legends.

This is the story of Julieta, a female golden dart frog, in search of her Romeo. She's about to lay her eggs and must find a male to fertilize them. Romeo's calls guide her through the forest, but crossing the dense rainforest is no easy feat.

The shadowy forests of Yala National Park are the perfect hideout for secretive leopards. It's time for one young female, Asha, to strike out alone. Join her as she fights for her own territory, finds a mate, and becomes a mother.

Go to extremes, from the Sahara to the outback, where animals are teaching us how to survive in our heating world. Shelter in caves with chimps, see camels sip salt water, and listen as zebra finches sing to their eggs to make their chicks smaller.

Sense the excitement as the Wendigo Farms staff prepare for the birth of the centre's first foal. Watch preparations kick into high gear as labour begins, then feel everyone's concern when things don't go as planned.

Go on a team retreat with Tammy as she helps everyone regroup after the tragic death of the barn's first foal. Witness the frustration as the group struggles to communicate, before Tammy takes Megan to task over her bad attitude.

Get a ringside seat at the most important equestrian event of the season, where Allie’s best efforts aren’t enough to bring home an award. Watch the day go from bad to worse when Tammy and Megan get into yet another monumental argument.

Get a first impression of Courtney, the new boarder, as Tammy and Allie grapple with managing the barn now that Megan has resigned. Tag along with Megan, who visits a friend in Alberta looking for greener pastures and a fresh start.

Brace for fallout as Tammy blows a gasket after Courtney is rude to Jamie and Alex. In Alberta, Megan isn't as lucky finding new employment as she'd hoped, and feels the stress as she finally decides to head home.
Megan swallows her pride and asks for her job back at Wendigo Farms. Tammy's hot young date shows up at the barn uninvited. Allie briefs Mike on a drastic strategy for winning Tammy back.

Celebrate as Allie cashes in on a horse while Tammy shocks the barn by announcing her wedding is next weekend. Join a whirlwind dress-shopping spree and watch Megan take over Allie's lesson with Courtney—with less than stellar results.

The workers at the St. Louis Zoo address the nutritional needs of animal family groups, including a herd of elephants with multiple generations, meerkat siblings, and a young tree kangaroo who needs to eat his first solid meal.

The employees at the St. Louis Zoo attempt to properly manage the nutritional needs of zoo residents who are picky eaters or who have complex dietary needs, including a giant anteater, a group of giraffes and a group of lemurs.

Confront Benji's heart murmur with Dr Chris, who feels it before he hears it, and see how a referral to a skilled surgeon could save the pup's life. Travel to a Tasmanian devil sanctuary and look on as Dr Lisa aids two kittens in distress.
City boy Dr Scott tries rural vet life in Wales, wrestling a feisty ram and saving a foal from a life-threatening hernia, plus an up-close look at a farmer's prized bull.

The advance preparations for Hope's open house extravaganza become sidetracked as a patient unexpectedly goes missing; the grand event reaches the heights of popularity, but it may possibly be too successful for its own good.

Explore the labour-intensive agricultural operations at the Smithsonian National Zoo. Acres of hay and bamboo are grown to help meet the needs of big eaters like the gorillas and bison, while also providing enrichment to a trio of lemurs.
Otters, siamangs and Sumatran tigers demonstrate how zoo food provides more than nutrition—it also stimulates playful behaviour that keeps animals more content.
Watch as zoo staff must focus their energy on two herds of asian elephants after one of the herds arrives from another zoo. Can food help these elephant families bond?

On this episode of MythBusters, Adam and Jamie take on a blockbuster bath-bomb, while Kari, Tory and Grant take to the skies for a flock formation investigation.
The search for the next generation of MythBusters wraps up as the final four tackle their toughest myths yet. Winners are announced live from the Liberty Science Center in New Jersey.

The MythBusters explore the science of speed. Can a toy car beat a real car down a quarter-mile track? Then Jamie suits up for a dangerous pond-skimming attempt to unlock the secrets of motorcycle hydroplaning.

Adam Savage and the team are challenged by Breaking Bad creator Vince Gilligan to prove just how destructive a giant magnet can be, and the team investigates how everyday furniture can block a door from Hollywood's deadliest villains.
In this controversial episode, the Mythbusters pit Men against Women in the ultimate Battle of the Sexes. Get set for all-out war as the team tests five age-old gender-based cliches.
In this episode that level of fan interaction has peaked in a Reddit Special. Adam and Jamie literally put the editorial of the show in the fans hands.

In this episode of Mythbusters, we could find out that pride comes before a fall. The same myth leads Adam to pit his mouth against a dog’s in a “who would you like to kiss most?” contest. Confused? You won’t be. It all makes perfect sense. In the reality that is the Mythbusters’ at least.

The MythBusters team up with all-star pitcher Matt Cain to tackle a batch of mini myths. Can you ride a bike underwater? Can a Shaolin Monk pierce glass with a needle? Does the potty dance actually help?

Jon and Brian tackle an explosive caper and a canine conundrum. First, Dynamite Deposit—a cunning safe cracker puts a timed explosive in a bag, has the bank manager lock it in the safe, then waits for the loot.

Take cover, on this episode of MythBusters, Jamie and Adam get test if an ordinary water heater, has the extraordinary ability to fly like a rocket, right through your house. This is a tale of explosive transformation.
Mythbusters Airplane Hour takes off! Adam and Jamie attempt to land a commercial plane in NASA's flight simulator—with zero flying experience.

First up Adam and Jamie tackle three extraordinary viral videos of Exuberant Excavators. Kari, Grant and Tory, take the team’s favourite tacky tape to it’s high flying limits in a tale from the wild Northwest.

In this episode of Mythbusters, Adam and Jamie try a test with a ton of toast, the build team head up a myth that’s one big yawn, and the whole gang decamp to Lake Tahoe for the most mismatched motor car race of all time.

Adam and Jamie explore the theory that if a high-tension cable snaps it can slice a person in two. Then, Grant, Tory and Kari investigate the myth that ancient pottery contains sounds from the past that can be heard today.
We've all heard about avalanches and their destructive power and it's no surprise that they are more shrouded in myth than a mountain is shrouded in cloud. And it's time to put that to the test.
Over millennia, the Arctic's inhabitants have evolved to survive in a challenging but stable and predictable world. Now, they must rapidly adapt to a new and constantly changing environment.
Devon Island is the largest uninhabited island in the world. It's so remote and forbidding that when scientists wanted to simulate living conditions on Mars, they chose Devon.
The Western Arctic's mammoth Mackenzie Delta is the second largest in North America after the Mississippi. It is a biological transition zone - from the boreal forest to the ever frozen tundra.
Take a closer look at the rivalries that shape animal life in the Serengeti.
The episode explores what is at stake for animals that have no permanent home, relying entirely on the ground they stand on for survival.
Experience the power of water, which shapes every area of life in the Serengeti.
Observe the fragile and evolving friendship between humans and elephants.
Source to Sea is the story of a river and its lifetime endeavor to deliver water from mountain to ocean, completing the Earth's stunningly well designed hydrological system.
These animals of the savanna, finding water means the difference between life and death in good years and bad - and after a long, punishing dry season the scorched earth is in dire need of moisture.
The African Penguin is the only penguin species that breeds in Africa, and it is found nowhere else.
At the southern edge of the Pantanal, the world's largest tropical wetland on Earth, there's a place like no other, and a wildlife so diverse scientists scramble to understand it.
In the heart of the Pantanal wetlands lies a region so remote that it is almost entirely unvisited. 300 pig-like peccaries call this unique place their home.

p.d: Mama Twiga in the Garden of Eden tells the emotional story of a mother giraffe, Mama Twiga, and the struggles of young giraffes and gazelles as they take on the risks of growing in the wilds of Swahili.
The river really belongs to the hippos. The world's largest concentrations of hippos are found here. They spend their days submerged, keeping cool in the hot sun.
Along the bank of the Luangwa River in Zambia is a troop of eighty or so baboons. This is the story of a family, and a young male baboon who faces difficult choices as he comes of age.

Monique is the mother of 8 children and tired of being accused about cheating on her husband Ricky by his mother Doris. Then Sandy fears the love of her life Chris is cheating on her, when she finds a secret recording of him with another women.

An aunt seeks an intervention for her teen niece Deborah who parties, smokes, drinks and neglects her baby. Later, Trisha helps a teen mom who believes it’s her right to party and do drugs while her adopted parents care for her 3-month old son.

Q’s girlfriend India is convinced that Q is cheating with her ex Jon-Nae. Can India handle the truth? Then, 27-year old Autumn was warned by her boyfriend Jim’s own family members that he was a cheater. But she didn’t listen.

Savannah claims Mitch denied being her father because of his alcoholism, violent ways and her marriage to an African American. Mitch claims that her mother specifically told him that Savannah is not his child. Is Mitch the father?

Jody decided to tell his daughter Kimberly at the age of 7 that he isn't her father because of a spat he had with her mother Laura. But 13 years later, Jody has a change of heart and wants to get back involved in Kimberly's life.

Chad’s mother and sister, both named Tammy, claim his ex-girlfriend April cheated. They think she was with other men during the entire relationship and her 3 children may not be his. Later, Kira says her boyfriend Terry is a cheater!

Jessica confessed that she cheated on William before, now he doesn’t believe that he fathered her son because the baby is white, but he’s black. Later, Byron says that Jacqueline is a liar and cheater and demands a lie detector test!

John is a stripper and Alicia wants to know if he's ever cheated on her at one of his shows. Then, Randy thinks that Wynter is with him for his money. But today she'll learn that he makes money by giving therapeutic sex massages!
Trisha Goddard continues her on-going series, Teen Girls: Bad Choices. Meet a 15-year old girl who claims she’s a pimp and is having relationships with men and women. Can Trisha intervene in time?

Eddie wants to marry Naomi, but before he can do that he must confess his secrets. Will Naomi stay with Eddie once she hears what he has to say? And later, Rolisha claims her boyfriend DJ has a wandering eye.

Tyrone claims Rona's mother was the neighborhood hot girl, so he doesn't believe that she is his daughter. And later, Rebecca wants to find out if the rumors are true that 19- year old Tommy is truly her father Randy's son.

Eric’s ex-girlfriend Amber wants to prove that he is the father of her child. Amber blames Eric’s mother Lee for trying to convince him otherwise. Then, Brandi wants to prove to her ex-boyfriend Rahsaan is NOT the father of her daughter.

Devin and LeeLee will fight anyone who confronts them. Both of them enjoy the attention their fight videos attract and view it as a sign of respect. Their parents are incredibly worried about the wayward path their children are headed down.

Antoine has been hiding the fact that he is gay from his family and his girlfriend. Now he wants to let them know the truth, and furthermore, that he has been having a relationship with his sister's boyfriend.

A volcano is erupting spewing choking ash and burning lava and bodies litter the ground around the Stargate. The team gathers up a few survivors and returns through the gate to Earth. The Tollans however are not grateful for being rescued. Their leader Omoc dismisses human society as primitive refuses to answer any questions about his planet's highly advanced technology and demands to be relocated to a similarly advanced world. Narim another Tollan reveals the reason for Omoc's suspicion.

Daniel Jackson is pulled into an alternate reality where he sees earth being invaded by the Goa ''uld.

Part one of three. Cost-conscious Senator Kinsey vows to shut down the Stargate project, riding roughshod over Daniel's objections and contemptuously dismissing the danger of an imminent attack by the Goa'uld. Richard Dean Anderson stars.

To stop the Goa'uld invasion, the SG-1 team disobeys orders and transports itself to the Goa'uld attack headquarters. Landing amidst preparations for an all-out strike on Earth, the way home is blocked. Can the team avert disaster and save humanity?

As a fleet of Goa'uld warships heads toward Earth, threatening to destroy it, the Stargate facility prepares for the worst, sending the best and brightest of American society through the Stargate to a safe Alpha site.

On a daring mission to rescue victims of an interplanetary attack, Carter's body is inhabited by a Goa'uld. And now that Carter has brought the demon back to Earth inside her, the SG-1 team must find a way to destroy it....without destroying Carter!
While exploring a seemingly insignificant planet, Col. Jack O'Neill and the SG-1 team are approached by a ragged figure who pleads for their help from a pursuer named Taldor.

While investigating an unknown planet, the SG-1 team discovers enigmatic structures that appear to contain various unconscious people; after being captured, the team is forced to relive painful memories from their pasts.

Daniel finds himself becoming increasingly involved in a romance with the stunningly attractive Princess of an alien civilization, and he finds that his newfound situation has granted him the chance to save the SG-1 from a harrowing fate.
The SG-1 team travel to the planet of Cimmeria to protect it from a massive Goa'uld attack.

While exploring a now-dead planet, Col. Jack O'Neill and the SG-1 team find an orb that sends out electromagnetic signals. They think it is a time capsule of some sort and are intrigued by its power source, which seems to have lasted a millennium.

SG-1 goes on a mission to rescue Teal'c's son, Rya'c, from the grasp of Apophis. But, when they finally reach Rya'c, he doesn't want to be saved -- he's been brainwashed and has accepted Apophis as his god! Can Teal'c find a way to win back his son?
Daniel Jackson learns that his wife is pregnant with Apophis' child and O'Neill discovers that a reporter is ready to blow the lid off the top-secret Stargate project.

O'Neill and the team are attacked by giant insects while exploring a new planet and try to retreat through the Stargate, but Teal'c is stung before they can escape. Once back at the SGC, he begins to undergo a terrifying transformation. Sci-fi drama, starring Christopher Judge and Richard Dean Anderson

The fishermen of Gloucester, Massachusetts, set out for Jeffrey's Ledge in hopes of catching the first fish of the North Atlantic Bluefin Tuna Season.
It's week two of the North Atlantic Blue Fin Tuna Season, and the Gloucester captains and their crews, from rookies to old pros, get put to the test.
Bad weather threatens to end the fishing week for the Gloucester fishermen, but while some boats head for home, others decide to take on Mother Nature's wrath.
As the hunt for blue fin tuna intensifies, the fisherman resort to espionage for information.

Last year's champion, Capt. Tyler of the Pin Wheel, has only one fish this season, but when he goes back to the lucky spot which served him so well in the past, he finds Capt. T.J. and the crew of the Hot Tuna are already there.
As the fleet charges into the heart of the season, it’s a tight race for the coveted title of top-earning boat
It's almost halfway through the North Atlantic bluefin tuna season and the Gloucester fleet has hit a lull in fishing.
